title: Stock bot intensive evidence rubric
grade_warning: C is a qualitative judgment of overall development maturity, not a calculated rubric score, profitability rating or execution approval.

score_anchors.0: Failed or absent; distinguishes observed failure from missing evidence in status.
score_anchors.1: Documented design or isolated unit evidence only.
score_anchors.2: Passing reproducible production-path offline integration including relevant positive and fault cases.
score_anchors.3: Representative authentic source replay and/or authenticated paper observation applicable to this criterion, with complete trace and independent review.
score_anchors.4: Repeated prospective or actual-host evidence meeting preregistered limits, drift monitoring and reviewed recovery, where applicable.

missing_evidence_policy: Null scores remain in denominator for conservative lower bound but are never called observed failures. Do not publish completed numeric grade until all items assessed.

gates.name: Authentic authorized source and complete chronology
gates.rationale: No independently verified complete creator feed/replay; inaccessible Instagram/member posts remain outside coverage.

gates.name: Faithful instructions including held-position exits
gates.rationale: Unsupported ambiguous instructions are guarded; complete production close/trim coordination remains unfinished.

gates.name: Account-bound risk and feasible capital
gates.rationale: Controls exist; intended paper budgets and observed account feasibility are not certified.

gates.name: Exactly-once lifecycle and cash/inventory integrity
gates.rationale: Intermittent synthetic replay duplicate-order/extra-fill anomaly remains unexplained; not the resolved Oct14 broker fee concern.

gates.name: Durable exit recovery on actual host
gates.rationale: PR28 improves in-process lookup during missing/zero quote; durable trigger intent and actual host recovery remain incomplete.

gates.name: Actual monitoring, escalation and secure deployment
gates.rationale: Persistent deployment, actual notification observations and security attestations remain incomplete.

gates.name: Authentic executable replay with complete outcomes
gates.rationale: No complete authenticated creator/options dataset; unresolved trades prohibit profitability comparison.

gates.name: Frozen strategy passes prospective economic criteria
gates.rationale: SPY selected blend failed later-period superiority; tested ORB/VWAP lost. No options profitability inference.
